title: MCP Explained: The USB-C for AI Agents #tech #agent #ai
description:
Before MCP, connecting an AI agent to any external tool meant custom code every single time. Slack integration, custom code. Notion integration, custom code. Stripe integration, custom code. Hundreds of hours of plumbing for every new connection.

MCP changes that entirely. Model Context Protocol is a universal standard. Any tool that supports it plugs into any agent that supports it without a single line of custom integration work. Slack has an MCP server. Notion has one. Stripe has one. Your agent reads the available tools and uses them. Setup time drops from days to minutes.

The adoption numbers say everything. MCP went from two million downloads a month at launch to ninety-seven million by March 2026. The entire ecosystem is converging on this standard.

The businesses connecting MCP servers instead of building custom integrations are moving five times faster than everyone else. 

That gap is only going to grow.
